decision.explanation: The Cotton kurta was delivered in the wrong size (L instead of ordered M), qualifying as a wrong item claim under policy section E11 and E3. It is within the 10-day return window (delivered on 2026-09-13, today is 2026-09-15). The item price is ₹1499 which is over ₹500, so refund will be processed after pickup. Photo evidence is required for wrong items above ₹2000 only, so no evidence required here. User must confirm to proceed with scheduled return pickup and refund via original UPI payment method, amount ₹1499 (full item price, no shipping refunded as per policy E12 since wrong item rules include shipping refund but only after pickup).
